tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Conditions as per tender Documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Name and Address of Organization Whether proprietary / partnership/ Company/ Pvt. Ltd. Phone No Mobile No Fax No Email address
GST Registration certificate and Oct-2026 Month GST 3B Form
Annual Turnover for the last 3 years(2022-23,2023-24 &2024-25),duly certified by Chartered Accountant, IT returns will not be considered.
Letter of authority issued by the manufacturer authorizing the tenderer to quote his product for the current tender in original
List of Similar supplies made in the last three years, Users Certificate as per format Section-V and Supply order copies.

Copy of Manufacture license for the equipment, if tenderer is a Manufacturer else Authorized Agency certificate from Principal manufacturer in original in format Section IV if tenderer is an authorized agent and Also submit the Manufacturer License.
Self declaration stating the firm is not black listed with any Government /Quasi Government Organizations and will not supply Refurbished equipments
A compliance certificate stating that the bidder complies with all Technical specification as per Tender document should be uploaded
Tender processing fee in the form of DD favor of Director KHPIMS Gadag. of Rs.3000/- Should be submitted at the time of Original document verification evaluation.
IT returns of the firm for the last 3 Financial years.( 2022-23,2023-24 &2024-25),and pan Card copy
